title: The Han Family of Tian Bei City
summary: At the Han Manor in Tian Bei City, Hong Chen of the Hong Clan, now a disciple of the Wind Lightning Pavilion, demands to marry both Han daughters, and the family head Han Chi refuses. Hong Lie and Hong Mu, two Four-Star Dou Huangs, ambush the convoy to take Han Xue, and Xiao Yan captures both in three moves, which tells Han Xue he was her hidden rescuer. At the manor, Xiao Yan finds that Han Xue's sister is Han Yue, his senior from Jia Nan Academy. Hong Chen offers a duel at Sky Stone Stage: if a Han of his generation beats him, the Hong Clan will leave the family alone for ten years, and if not, he marries both sisters. Xiao Yan offers to fight for the Han family, and their uncle Han Tian, an Eight-Star Dou Huang, tests him with the Nine Turning Wind Steps. Xiao Yan beats him with a trace of Spatial Strength, Han Tian admits defeat, and Han Chi promises to repay him at any price.
events: Hong Chen, a new Wind Lightning Pavilion disciple, demands both Han daughters; Han Chi refuses.
